newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Corp marches higher in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Sony Corp marches higher in early morning trade.

text.p: Sony Corp marched higher in early Thursday morning trade as investor interest in the share continued after it hit a new high for the year on Wednesday, brokers said.
As of 0021 GMT, the shares were 21 yen higher at 7,450 yen. It was the 11th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo exchange with 795,900 shares changing hands.
"There is much liquidity in the share, especially since it hit a new high on Wednesday and that is attracting investor attention," a middle-sized brokerage broker said.
"Institutional investors are buying Sony shares because they are beginning to feel that it is a 'must-have' share," he added.
